title: FarmLand Mortgage Note Terms for Farm Real Estate Loans: Amortization, Installment Frequency and Day Count
content:
Under every Farm Real Estate Loans note, three terms fix the shape of the repayment schedule:

1. **Longest amortization** — the longest amortization from closing to maturity, in years.
2. **Installment frequencies allowed** — the installment frequencies the member may choose at closing.
3. **Interest day-count convention** — every FarmLand product uses the actual/365 convention: for each calendar day, interest is the principal multiplied by the annual rate and divided by 365.

## Terms by product

| Product | Longest amortization (years) | Installment frequencies the member may choose at closing | Day-count convention |
|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 30 | monthly, semiannual, annual | actual/365 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 30 | monthly, semiannual, annual | actual/365 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 30 | monthly, semiannual, annual | actual/365 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 30 | semiannual, annual | actual/365 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | semiannual, annual | actual/365 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 25 | annual | actual/365 |

## Reading the terms

- A monthly installment schedule is available only on the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage and the 3-Year and 5-Year adjustable mortgages; the 25-Year Fixed Mortgage is repaid in annual installments only.
- The frequency is chosen at closing from the list for the product being closed.
- The day count is calendar-day based: every calendar day of a period earns one day of interest, and the year is always counted as 365 days.

**One day of interest (hypothetical figures).** On a principal of USD 365000 at an annual rate of 7.000 percent, one calendar day of interest is USD 365000 multiplied by 7 percent, which is USD 25550, divided by 365, which is USD 70.00. Thirty days at the same principal and rate earn thirty times that daily figure. The principal and rate are example inputs only.
